description: Defines enums, structs, and conversion functions related to PSUP PDU session information, including downlink and uplink session data, for 3GPP TS 38.415 specifications.

classes.name: psup_dl_pdu_session_information
classes.description: Represents downlink PDU session information with fields for QoS, timing, and policy indicator.

classes.name: psup_ul_pdu_session_information
classes.description: Represents uplink PDU session information with fields for QoS, timing, and delay measurements.

methods.name: psup_pdu_type_to_uint
methods.description: Converts PDU type enum to its integer representation.

methods.name: uint_to_psup_pdu_type
methods.description: Converts an integer to its corresponding PDU type enum.

methods.name: psup_ppi_to_uint
methods.description: Converts PPI enum to its integer representation.

methods.name: uint_to_psup_ppi
methods.description: Converts an integer to its corresponding PPI enum.
